sentences.en: For my presentation today I'm going to talk about some of the issues facing the cruise ship industry and then some ways these can be addressed. The cruise ship industry has partly been responsible for the effects of overtourism in recent decades. Overtourism occurs in places where excessive numbers of tourists cause significant problems. Pollution, for example, is among the greatest threats to many popular tourist destinations.
sentences.zh: 今天我的演讲将探讨邮轮产业面临的一些问题，以及解决这些问题的一些方法。近几十年来，邮轮产业在一定程度上导致了过度旅游现象的发生。过度旅游是指游客数量过多、从而引发严重问题的地区。例如，污染是许多热门旅游目的地面临的最大威胁之一。

sentences.en: Of course, for many places it's a difficult balance to achieve. They want to promote their city or island as a desirable tourist destination, but at the same time, are unable to cope with thousands of cruise ship passengers on a daily basis. The trouble is, excessive tourism is destroying the beauty spots and places of interest that people come to visit. Several cities, such as Barcelona, have responded by imposing a tax which all visitors to the city from cruise ships have to pay. But as it's only a couple of euros, many green campaigners think it won't deter enough people to make any difference.
sentences.zh: 当然，对许多地方而言，这是一道难以把握的平衡题：它们希望将自身城市或岛屿打造为理想的旅游目的地，但同时又无法应对每天成千上万邮轮乘客带来的压力。问题在于，过度旅游正在破坏人们慕名而来的风景名胜与人文景点。包括巴塞罗那在内的多个城市已采取措施，向所有乘邮轮抵达该市的游客征收一笔税费。但由于这笔费用仅几欧元，许多环保人士认为它不足以阻止足够多的游客，因而无法产生实质影响。

sentences.en: Bruges is another city which became impossible to navigate at times because of the huge numbers of cruise passengers arriving on day trips from the port of Zeebrugge. The city was becoming like a 'theme park', with shops only catering for tourists, selling chocolate, which Belgium is famous for, and other souvenirs. The local council took action to limit cruise passengers to a more manageable level.
sentences.zh: 布鲁日是另一座因大量邮轮乘客从泽布吕赫港一日游涌入而一度变得难以通行的城市。该城正逐渐变成一座‘主题公园’——商店只面向游客，售卖比利时著名的巧克力及其他纪念品。当地市政委员会已采取行动，将邮轮乘客数量限制在更易管理的水平。

sentences.en: Dubrovnik had to limit the numbers of cruise ships after it became extremely popular as a cruise ship destination when it featured in a hugely successful TV series. What it does now is control the timing of all cruise ship entries to the city's port. However, many people feel this measure does not go far enough.
sentences.zh: 杜布罗夫尼克在一部大获成功的电视剧中出镜后，迅速成为热门邮轮目的地，不得不开始限制停靠邮轮的数量。目前，该市通过管控所有邮轮进入其港口的时间来加以管理。然而，许多人认为这一措施仍远远不够。

sentences.en: Cruise ships may be unpopular in some of their destinations but they also have an image problem. They've always been perceived as a safe holiday for the elderly, with not much on offer for families or young couples. A recent survey showed that cost is also a major factor in putting younger groups off going on a cruise. But what they don't realise is that compared to other types of package holidays, cruises can actually be good value, as all activities and drinks are often included. And another perception is that cruises have lots of rules about what to wear and how to behave. But these days, most cruises are no longer very formal and behind the times.
sentences.zh: 邮轮在部分目的地虽不受欢迎，自身也存在形象问题。长期以来，邮轮被视作专为老年人提供的安全假期，对家庭或年轻情侣却缺乏吸引力。最近一项调查显示，价格高昂也是令年轻群体却步的主要因素之一。但他们并未意识到，与其他类型的打包度假产品相比，邮轮其实性价比很高，因为船上活动及饮品通常均已包含在内。另一种普遍看法是，邮轮对穿着和行为规范有诸多限制。但如今，大多数邮轮已不再拘泥于繁文缛节，也不再陈旧过时。

sentences.en: So what solutions are there for cruise lines to overcome some of these problems? How can they appeal to younger customers? Well one selling point is that cruise ships are becoming more sustainable. New ships are built with hybrid engines with large batteries which means ships do not have to keep their engines running while docked.
sentences.zh: 那么，邮轮公司有哪些解决方案可应对上述部分问题？又该如何吸引年轻客户呢？其中一个卖点在于，邮轮正变得越来越可持续。新型邮轮配备混合动力引擎及大型电池，这意味着船舶靠港时无需持续运转发动机。

sentences.en: Cruise lines are also designing ships specially for those in the age range of 21 to 45. The decor in these feels contemporary and there are a range of activities on board that you wouldn't find on a more traditional cruise. There's even a boxing ring on one ship, and most offer diving expeditions. But there's also a huge focus on well-being with a variety of sessions of different kinds.
sentences.zh: 邮轮公司还专门针对21至45岁年龄段旅客设计新船。这类邮轮内部装潢现代感十足，船上活动种类丰富，远超传统邮轮所能提供。其中一艘邮轮甚至配备了拳击台，多数邮轮还提供潜水探险项目。此外，健康养生也成为重点，提供多种类型、形式各异的养生课程。

sentences.en: Food is always a very important part of any cruise and cruise ships have had to radically update their menus to suit the tastes of their younger customers. Vegan dishes are standard, for example. The restaurants on board have also gone paperless with menus available on screen.
sentences.zh: 美食始终是任何一次邮轮之旅的重要组成部分，而邮轮公司也必须彻底更新菜单，以迎合年轻顾客的口味。例如，纯素食菜品已成为标配。船上餐厅亦全面实现无纸化，菜单均以屏幕形式呈现。

sentences.en: Unlike older generations who went on cruises largely to get away from everything, younger people expect to be able to keep in touch with friends and family. Many people going on longer cruises also spend time working, so companies have to guarantee wifi that can be relied upon at all times.
sentences.zh: 与老一辈人主要为远离一切而选择邮轮不同，年轻人期望能随时与亲友保持联系。许多参加长期邮轮旅行的人还会利用时间工作，因此邮轮公司必须确保全程提供稳定可靠的Wi-Fi服务。

sentences.en: My grandparents used to love looking through cruise brochures, even when they weren't planning on going on a cruise. Until very recently TV ads for cruises always felt dated and aimed at retirees. Cruise lines have been slow to adopt the power of social media but that's all changing. Leading cruise lines now employ top agencies to produce first rate videos for social media channels.
sentences.zh: 我祖父母过去常爱翻阅邮轮宣传册，即便当时并无出游计划。直到不久前，邮轮电视广告仍显得过时，目标受众明显是退休人群。邮轮公司采纳社交媒体力量的步伐一直较为迟缓，但如今这一状况正在改变。主流邮轮公司目前已聘请顶尖广告公司，为其社交媒体平台制作一流水准的视频。
